description: Use this to check one Handshake (an agreed trade) and what your side still needs to do. The `payment.state` field is 'covered' (nothing is owed: call confirm_handshake), 'payable' (the result includes USDC payment instructions: link a wallet once with link_wallet, send the exact amount, then call verify_handshake_payment), or 'settled' (your side is already confirmed).
name: get_handshake
title: Get a Handshake
